title: Page from paper
description: A page from the learner's paper that the device holds, paper/<profile id>/<page id>.json, which app writes beside api.zip: the photo of the page, its task frames, and each picked task's crop and work. The server keeps none of it.

format.description: The version of the part, the integer in export/VERSION.

profile_id.description: The ID of the profile whose page it is.

page_id.description: The ID of the page, as app gave it.

taken_at.description: When the learner took the photo, or picked it.

photo.description: The photo of the page, without the metadata of its file, as it was sent to find its tasks.

frames.description: The task frames of the page, those the AI found and those the learner drew, in the order app shows them; a frame the learner removed is not here.

tasks.description: The tasks picked on the page, in the order of their attempts.

by.description: Who framed the task: the AI that found the tasks, or the learner by hand.

task_frame.description: A rectangle round one task on the photo of the page.

attempt_id.description: The attempt of the task, as api gave it.

frame.description: The task's frame, by its place in frames, from 1.

statement.description: The task's crop as app cut it by its frame, without the learner's strokes.

history.description: The history of writing as the canvas gave it, the strokes of the sheet and of the tracing paper: write/erase/cut/clear/tutor/undo events with t, a cut with the pieces it left, a tutor event — the tutor's act in grown-up mode — with the strokes it wrote and the IDs it took off; strokes with id, kind, style and points x, y, t, p; on a stroke or a tutor event of the tracing paper, on "tracing".

tracing.description: Where the tracing paper lay at the end, whether it was hidden and its scale, as the canvas gave it: at [x, y], hidden and scale, absent meaning 1.

items.description: A submission's context, as the canvas gave it, and the history length when it was sent: one of them.

submissions.description: Each submission of the task, in order: its context, as the canvas gave it, and the history length when it was sent.

task.description: A picked task of the page: its crop and its work, as the device holds them.
